issues.failure_explanation: The singular values of the Lyapunov operator L = I⊗A + A⊗I are not sums of singular values of A; for a Hurwitz A they can be far smaller than 2σ_min(A). Counterexample: A = [[-1,10],[-10,-1]] is normal and Hurwitz with σ_min(A)=√101≈10.05, but E = I gives R = AE+EA^T = A+A^T = -2I, so ‖E‖_2 = 1 while the claimed bound ‖R‖_F/(2σ_min(A)) = 2√2/(2√101) ≈ 0.14. Hence σ_min(L) (here 2) is not 2σ_min(A) and inequality (eqn:lyap:errorResidual) is false. The correct constant is 1/σ_min(L), which for general Hurwitz A is neither 1/(2σ_min(A)) nor O(n)-computable; only for dissipative A does one get ‖E‖_F ≤ ‖R‖_F/(2λ_min(-(A+A^T)/2)), and even then λ_min of the symmetric part, not σ_min(A), is the right quantity.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must replace 2σ_min(A) by a valid lower bound for σ_min(L) throughout prop1, teo1, (eq33) and (eq:52). This requires either an added hypothesis (e.g. A+A^T ≺ 0, using 2λ_min(-(A+A^T)/2)) that excludes non-dissipative Hurwitz matrices, or computing/bounding σ_min(L) itself, which abandons the O(n)-computable certificate.
issues.overall_effect: The certified stopping criterion of Theorem teo1 (the paper's first main contribution, 'rigorous, computable error guarantees' with ‖X−X̃‖_2 ≤ tol) is invalid as stated for general Hurwitz A. The estimate (eq33) of ‖L^{-1}Π‖_2, the rescaling recipe (eq:52) meant to enforce Assumption ass:statIterGLE and γ≈1, and the practical tolerance splitting all rest on the same false identity and can underestimate the error by arbitrary factors.
issues.title: False identity sigma_min(L) = 2 sigma_min(A) invalidates the Lyapunov error-residual bound and all derived GLE certificates
issues.why_classification: The main GLE guarantee is false for the advertised class (arbitrary Hurwitz A); every valid resolution either excludes an advertised regime or gives up the cheaply computable constant on which the certification claim rests.
